newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaican government to take over bank group.
newsitem.headline: Jamaican government to take over bank group.

text.p: Lines formed outside some branches of the Eagle Financial Group's banks on Wednesday after chairman Dr. Paul Chen-Young said the Jamaican government was preparing to take it over.
Chen-Youg disclosed the decision to group directors on Tuesday following a break-down in talks over how to proceed with a government-funded bailout plan.
The group, with total assets of US$300 million, includes two hotels managed by the Holiday Inn chain and a Miami investment bank, First Equity.

The group's life subsidiary, Crown Eagle, faced a run on its equity-linked deposits three years ago. It was forced to borrow from Eagle Commercial Bank, which in turn had to run an overdraft with the central bank of J$2 billion.
